title: step2cam plan, version 1
description: What plan::plan writes: per setup, what to cut, independent of tools and machine. Lengths in mm, in the setup's frame unless named _model. After capp::finish every operation also names its tool (tool), or says why it has none (tool_note, null when nothing needs saying). The decision trace: decisions lists every choice and the rule (rulebase/rules.json, id@version) it was made by; an operation's because and a skipped feature's decision name them. step2cam::process returns the plan without the roughing mesh (positions, indices) or part_surface, as the page has the mesh already.

part_surface.description: Set by capp::exclude when roughing is refused, so the finished stock can still be compared with the part; step2cam::process removes it from what it returns.
